title: Chronon3D Per-Node Stats Report v1
description: Canonical schema for the per-session --node-memory-json report emitted by chronon3d_bench. It serializes NodeMemoryTracker snapshots after warmup; it is separate from the fusion-oriented --stats-json output.

session_id.description: Unique per-session identifier (UUIDv4 recommended) so concurrent sessions in CI logs do not collide.

frame_count.description: Number of measured post-warmup render frames included in this report.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at the moment the NodeMemoryTracker was snapshotted (i.e. session end for serialize-to-file mode).

machine_class.description: Optional. Reference machine class (per configs/benchmark_machines.yaml); useful when the stats report is committed alongside bench baselines for cross-machine comparison.

nodes.description: Per-node aggregate of NodeMemoryMetrics. node_id is the stable graph/node id (g<n>:n<m>) when available, otherwise the node name.

node_id.description: Stable graph/node id (g<n>:n<m>) when available, otherwise RenderGraphNode::name().

node_type.description: RenderGraphNodeKind string, used to scope the hot-node allocation gate. ClearNode is reported as Output in this checkout.

pixels_read.description: Total pixels read by this node across the session (frame_count frames).

pixels_written.description: Total pixels written by this node across the session.

bytes_read.description: Total bytes read by this node across the session.

bytes_written.description: Total bytes written by this node across the session.

framebuffer_copies.description: Total framebuffer copy operations (incl. partial-tile copies) emitted by this node.

framebuffer_clears.description: Total framebuffer clear operations emitted by this node.

allocations.description: Framebuffer backing-store allocation events observed for this node, plus explicit allocation events.

allocated_bytes.description: Bytes associated with instrumented framebuffer backing-store and explicit allocation events.

temporary_buffers.description: Total temporary framebuffer-shaped buffers acquired by this node.

live_bytes.description: Current live temporary workspace bytes held by this node.

peak_live_bytes.description: High-water mark of live temporary workspace bytes held by this node.
